description: No vault entries for the current local snapshot configuration.

entries.help: Skillet creates the persistent scoped token; do not create disposable VM tokens manually.
Legacy production token read during migration. Do not create new entries at this path.

description: Shared inputs for Caddy and DDNS.

entries.help: Create an account-owned Cloudflare API token with Account API Tokens Write and Zone Read, restricted to the selected zones. [Permissions guide](ublue/skillet/README.md#secret-setup-and-delivery).
Copy the Zone ID from the selected zone's Cloudflare Overview page.
Choose a relative UI prefix, such as ui; absent defaults to ui. Skillet appends the zone domain. Do not enter a full domain.

description: One shared key serves production and test. No application key required for ingestion. Site is public template configuration, defaulting to datadoghq.com. [Setup](ublue/skillet/README.md#datadog).

entries.help: Create an ingestion API key in Datadog Organization Settings → API Keys. [Key guide](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/api-app-keys/).

For workstation monitor administration only: create a scoped Application Key in Datadog Organization Settings → Application Keys with monitors_read and monitors_write. Never deliver this key to hosts. [Key guide](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/api-app-keys/).

description: Prepare the shared Cloudflare token creator and Zone ID. [DDNS setup](ublue/skillet/README.md#optional-cloudflare-ddns).

entries.help: Choose the relative DNS record name, not a full domain.
Skillet creates the persistent scoped token; disposable tokens are lifecycle-owned.
Skillet generates and saves the web admin password for a fresh host; optionally create it to choose a password. For an existing host, restore its entry rather than inventing a replacement.

description: Production-only native Postfix relay credentials; smoke machines use a local sink without these values. [SMTP plan](ublue/plan/CLAMPS-EMAIL.md).

entries.help: Create one entry using your Mailjet SMTP credentials: Username = SMTP username; Password = SMTP password. Custom fields: host = in-v3.mailjet.com; port = 587; tls = starttls (required TLS with certificate verification); sender = a Mailjet-verified sender email address. [Mailjet credentials](https://documentation.mailjet.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043229473-How-can-I-configure-my-SMTP-parameters).

description: Generated independent LUKS root recovery passphrases. [Enrollment](ublue/skillet/README.md#root-recovery-keys). Password contains the printable passphrase; custom luks-uuid and recovery-state fields are managed by Skillet.

entries.help: Run skillet secrets root-recovery-key before finishing production provisioning. The command unlocks the vault, saves before enrollment, and verifies the key against this volume.
Run skillet test vm recovery-key HOST INSTANCE. Archived test keys remain in the vault after VM disposal; delete the instance entry before reusing its name for a new disk.

description: No vault entries currently required; Skillet manages the private UI configuration.

Create an OAuth client in Tailscale Trust credentials with Auth Keys Write and Devices Core Read/Write, restricted to the provisioner tag. [Tag and scope guide](ublue/skillet/README.md#tailscale-setup-for-skillet). Skillet mints enrollment keys; do not create per-host auth-key entries.

entries.help: Copy the OAuth Client ID from the creation page; use Password, not Username.
Copy the OAuth Client secret from the creation page.

description: No vault entries currently required. Controller/UI accounts are managed in UniFi, separately from Skillet provisioning.
